observations: All ten saved revised source masters were viewed, and native body/portrait comparison sheets were inspected. The base/upgrade equipment gap is visibly clearer than the first versions.
Recruit is now lightly padded; Vanguard has clear plate coverage, winged helmet and cape. Neither adopts the original polearm silhouette.
Both Rangers are female and have no bird. Hood/leather versus steel helmet/cuirass remains readable at native scale. Each carries one crossbow; no double-shot visual is implied.
Guardian has a flat weathered shield and plain helmet; Royal Guardian has broader carved shield geometry, crest and cape. Both remain human shield bearers.
Duelist has cloth cap and leather; Grand Duelist has steel cuirass, plumed helmet and short cape. A narrow rapier remains distinct from the Castle swordsman profile.
Sentinel is visibly rough and unornamented; Awakened has finished carved architectural armor. Both have grounded heavy feet and compact shoulder architecture, without flight wings.

Metal edges and carved stone are still cleaner and more uniformly bright than several original examples. Final texture/lighting judgment requires the actual battlefield and all actions; no professional-quality acceptance is granted.
Small32x32 full-body portraits are compact and need actual recruitment/stack UI review. Existing transparent bust exports do not prove final faction backdrops or UI integration.
